## Profile

I am a geographer and master's student based in Vienna. I hold a BSc in Geography and currently study *Geographies of Global Change and Sustainability Transformations* as well as Cultural and Social Anthropology at the University of Vienna.

My academic and project work focuses on urban geography, spatial inequality, accessibility and socially sustainable development. I am particularly interested in connecting spatial data analysis with an understanding of how urban environments are experienced, governed and transformed.

## Research approach

I combine quantitative spatial analysis with qualitative and policy-oriented research. Depending on the research problem, my work draws on GIS, SQL/PostGIS, statistical analysis, document analysis and qualitative coding.

This combination allows me to examine both the measurable spatial distribution of infrastructure and the social or institutional processes behind these patterns.

## Current interests

- Urban accessibility and everyday infrastructure
- Environmental justice and spatial inequality
- Housing and socially sustainable urban development
- Urban resilience and public infrastructure
- Mixed-methods urban research
